namespace PubAC19
structure TicketLock where
  serving : Nat
  nextTicket : Nat
def inv (s : TicketLock) : Prop := s.serving ≤ s.nextTicket
def issueTicket (s : TicketLock) : TicketLock := ⟨s.serving, s.nextTicket + 1⟩
def releaseLock (s : TicketLock) : TicketLock := if s.serving < s.nextTicket then ⟨s.serving + 1, s.nextTicket⟩ else s
def holdsLock (s : TicketLock) (t : Nat) : Prop := t = s.serving ∧ t < s.nextTicket
theorem issue_preserves_inv (s : TicketLock) (h : inv s) : inv (issueTicket s) := by sorry
theorem release_preserves_inv (s : TicketLock) (h : inv s) : inv (releaseLock s) := by sorry
theorem ticket_mutex (s : TicketLock) (t1 t2 : Nat) (h1 : holdsLock s t1) (h2 : holdsLock s t2) : t1 = t2 := by sorry
end PubAC19
